    Requirements

    FMOD Plus is an extension for FMOD for Unity. It does not include FMOD Studio, FMOD for Unity, banks, or an FMOD license.

    Dependency Supported version Notes
    Unity 6000.3 or newer The current verified environment is Unity 6000.5.5f1.
    FMOD for Unity 2.02.0 or newer and earlier than 3.0.0 The package version define accepts UPM SemVer [2.2.0,3.0.0). The current verified environment uses FMOD 2.03.14.

    FMOD Plus detects the package named com.firelight.fmod-for-unity. When a supported version is present, it defines FMOD_PRESENT and enables the Runtime and Editor assemblies. Without a supported FMOD package, only the independent Setup bootstrap remains available.

    Licensing

    Install FMOD for Unity separately and follow FMOD's licensing and distribution terms. FMOD Plus itself is distributed under the license shown in the License section.
